Script to sonify some data from Ethan

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load packages
library(tuneR) # audio handling
library(dplyr) # data manipulation
library(stringr) # string manipulation
library(readxl) # read in Excel data

# Load functions from MS_sonification directory
source("MS_sonification/functions.R")

# Read in AZ# to compound name reference table
AZ_ref <- read_excel("AZ/data/AZ COLLECTION.XLS", sheet = 1)
```

# MS
Chunk to sonify some mass spec data
```{r MS}
# Iterate over the AZ numbers to get some data
for(i in AZ_ref$`AZ#`){
    
    # Check if data is present
    if(file.exists(paste0("AZ/data/MS/OLD/MS/", i, ".CSV"))){
        
        # Read in the data
        MS_data <- read.csv(paste0("AZ/data/MS/OLD/MS/", i, ".CSV"))
        names(MS_data) <- c("mz", "intensity")
        
        # Make the tone
        MS_tone <- advanced_spectrum_to_tone(
            MS_data,
            duration = 5,
            # scale = TRUE,
            scale_min = 300,
            scale_max = 5000
        )
        
        # Make file path for output
        out_path <- paste0(
            "AZ/output/MS/",
            i,
            "_",
            AZ_ref$`Compound Name`[AZ_ref$`AZ#` == i],
            ".wav"
        )
        
        # Write to directory
        writeWave(MS_tone, file = out_path)
    }
}
```

# UV
Chunk to sonify (presumably) UV absorbance on LC??
```{r}
# Get list of files
UV_files <- list.files("AZ/data/UV/", pattern = "*.PRN")
UV_data <- read.delim(paste0("AZ/data/UV/", UV_files[1]), sep = "\t")
names(UV_data) <- c("mz", "intensity")
```
